base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a cosy circular kitchen-laboratory inside the lighthouse with curved copper walls, a mirror-polished salvage-metal table, a kettle, a ceiling fan, an armchair, half-finished gadgets everywhere, coiled cables, and a chaotic workbench. Lighting: warm morning light through round porthole windows.
In the shot: Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets.
Camera: Hero reveal, low angle, then medium shot.
Action: A welding mask flips up to reveal Tomkin. He steps back from a small gadget that floats, defying gravity, then spins round to a glowing holographic display of galactic market charts with a catnip-leaf ticker rising.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, smug) says: "Crypto-catnip up four percent. As predicted. By me."
Sound effects: mask clank, anti-gravity hum, hologram chimes, ambience of ticking gadgets, fridge hum, distant waves.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly: same characters, same designs, same setting, same lighting and same 3D animated style (Tomkin).
Action: Tomkin flicks the hologram with a claw, it zooms in on the rising chart, and he turns to camera with a smug half-smile, whiskers twitching.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, smug, to himself) says: "The only rational being in this entire building."
Sound effects continue: mask clank, anti-gravity hum, hologram chimes.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
